sourcing_note: Sourced from the FDA's official Complete Response Letter transparency dataset (download.open.fda.gov/approved_CRLs.zip, published under the FDA's CRL transparency initiative), a different systematic source than the FierceBiotech trial-failure retrospectives used in prior newly-sourced batches - CRLs are inherently negative regulatory events and this dataset gave application numbers with exact CRL dates, cross-referenced to sponsors via openFDA's drugsfda API and web search, then verified via SEC EDGAR / issuer press releases as with every other candidate in this cohort. Of 7 CRLs in the dataset dated within the 2018-2025 sampling frame, sponsors were identified for 3 (Omeros, Incyte, Regeneron); Incyte's retifanlimab CRL (Jul 23, 2021) was investigated but dropped - no 8-K was filed and no source gives an exact release time, so rather than force an imprecise timestamp it is left unresolved for now. Deduplicated against the full existing ticker/candidate_id set.

events.fda_source_identity: FDA Complete Response Letter dataset, application BLA125734, filename-dated 2021-08-18
events.notes: FDA stated it could not estimate narsoplimab's treatment effect in HSCT-TMA from the submitted data. The FDA transparency dataset's filename carries an 2021-08-18 date, about two months before Omeros' 2021-10-18 public disclosure; it is unclear whether that filename date is the original CRL issuance date or some other internal/administrative date (e.g. a later processing or database-entry date), so it is not relied on. The first_public_timestamp used for this candidate is exclusively Omeros' own confirmed public disclosure (2021-10-18), which is what the market could actually react to regardless of when the letter was received.

events.fda_source_identity: FDA Complete Response Letter dataset, application BLA761400, letter dated 2024-08-20
events.notes: Sole approvability issue was a third-party fill/finish manufacturer inspection finding unrelated to linvoseltamab's own efficacy/safety data; the FDA did not cite concerns with Regeneron's own data. No SEC 8-K was filed for this CRL (not deemed independently material against Regeneron's very large diversified pipeline/market cap), so the GlobeNewswire release itself, which explicitly displays 18:45 ET, is used directly as the primary source.
